name: Rafael Costa
bio:
Rafael's journey into motorsport finance began unexpectedly. He initially pursued a degree in Economics, but a chance internship with a local racing team ignited a passion he never knew he possessed. He quickly realized the crucial role financial management plays in a team's success, from securing sponsorships to optimizing resource allocation. 

Rafael approaches his role at AF Corse with meticulous attention to detail and a strong understanding of the sport's unique financial landscape. He's known for his ability to identify cost-saving opportunities without compromising performance. He's determined to help the team achieve financial stability and sustainable growth. 

What sets Rafael apart is his proactive approach to problem-solving and his ability to think outside the box. He's not afraid to challenge conventional wisdom and always seeks innovative solutions to financial challenges, ensuring AF Corse maintains a competitive edge.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly styled with a slight fade on the sides.
physical.description: Rafael is of average height with a lean build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always has a small stress ball shaped like a race car on his desk.
Meticulously organizes his spreadsheets with color-coding and specific naming conventions.
Drinks a cup of strong Brazilian coffee at precisely 3:00 PM every day.
